tools.name: upload_begin
tools.description: Called only by the JuzPost upload card, never by the model. Reserves storage for one file and starts a multipart upload. Returns media_key, upload_id, part_size and parts.

tools.name: upload_part
tools.description: Called only by the JuzPost upload card, never by the model. Stores one part of a file started with upload_begin: the original bytes as base64, exactly part_size bytes except the last part. Returns part_number and bytes.

tools.name: upload_finish
tools.description: Called only by the JuzPost upload card, never by the model. Completes an upload once every part is stored. Returns media_key, bytes and content_type.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_post" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "schedule_post" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_accounts, list_options, get_platform_limits, list_groups, list_posts, get_post, update_post, schedule_post, upload_file, upload_media · Private data: get_context, list_accounts, get_platform_limits, upload_file, upload_media, create_upload_url, upload_begin, upload_part · Public sink: list_options, get_platform_limits, list_groups, list_posts, get_post, create_post, update_post, delete_post, schedule_post, upload_file, upload_media, create_upload_url, upload_begin, upload_part, upload_finish · Destructive: delete_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_accounts, list_options, get_platform_limits, list_groups, list_posts, get_post, update_post, schedule_post, upload_file, upload_media · Private data: get_context, list_accounts, get_platform_limits, upload_file, upload_media, create_upload_url, upload_begin, upload_part · Public sink: list_options, get_platform_limits, list_groups, list_posts, get_post, create_post, update_post, delete_post, schedule_post, upload_file, upload_media, create_upload_url, upload_begin, upload_part, upload_finish · Destructive: delete_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
